│ MOD.02 · TRAIN — DRONE SURVEY TRAINING SIM                           │
│                                                                      │
│ Long-distance survey flying for field operators — weather, traffic,  │
│ wildlife, and the checks before and after you leave the ground. In   │
│ development.                                                         │
│                                                                      │
│ CORE                                                                 │
│   Realism-first sim for long-range survey work: plan the flight, fly │
│   the corridor, bring the data home.                                 │
│                                                                      │
│ DRILL                                                                │
│   Weather systems, air traffic, wildlife avoidance (birds, bears),   │
│   plus preflight and postflight inspection until they stick.         │
